description: This file contains the implementation of the BasketViewModelService class, which provides methods to retrieve, create, and map shopping basket data for users within the eShopWeb application. It interacts with repositories, query services, and uses specifications to fetch and process basket-related information.

classes.name: BasketViewModelService
classes.description: A service class providing methods to manage and transform basket data for the web UI, including creation, retrieval, and mapping of basket entities to view models.

methods.name: GetOrCreateBasketForUser
methods.description: Retrieves an existing basket for the specified user or creates a new one if none exists.

methods.name: CreateBasketForUser
methods.description: Creates a new basket entity for the specified user and returns its view model.

methods.name: GetBasketItems
methods.description: Converts a collection of BasketItem entities into a list of BasketItemViewModel objects, including fetching related catalog item details.

methods.name: Map
methods.description: Maps a Basket entity to a BasketViewModel, including related items.

methods.name: CountTotalBasketItems
methods.description: Returns the total count of items in a user's basket by querying the BasketQueryService.
